text:
elaine_sales: Heads-up  Orchid Retail escalated to execs. CISO insists on BYO KMS or HSM-backed keys and wants a firm throughput commitment for Black Friday-like peaks. Finance also asks for a capex-style purchase option. Can infra + legal own this? cc @sam_solutions @deepak_eng @karen_legal @maria_prod

sam_solutions: I can take infra coord. Need their expected TPS profile and p95/p99 SLOs. Any doc?

elaine_sales: They uploaded a rough traffic export. Peak ~12k req/min, mostly short chat requests, p95 target ~150ms. I'll paste the sheet link in calendar invite.

deepak_eng: Quick note: our current dedicated stack with warmed KV cache handles ~10k/min steady. For 12k we can either add a small reserved burst pool or configure a tighter autoscale profile. HSM requires Private or VPC peering for KMS, that adds lead time.

karen_legal: CISO wants explicit key custody and audit log addendum. I'll draft DPA language around BYO KMS, key rotation attestations, and access controls. Need to know which KMS vendors they're considering.

maria_prod: Setting a 30-min sync with their infra & sec at 4pm PT. Please confirm availability or delegate.

sam_solutions: 4pm works. @deepak_eng can you prepare two ops options (reserved burst vs autoscale) with rough cost delta? Simple numbers we can share with finance.

deepak_eng: Will prepare by 2:30pm. Also note: if they require HSM we should surface timeline impact (~3-4w for private deployment + certs) and incremental cost.

jamie_se: Pricing can do a capex model for a 12-month reserved pool. I need the delta monthly cost between reserved and burst to build amortized capex.

ops_bot: Ticket INC-41288 created: "Orchid Retail exec escalation - KMS BYO + throughput asks". Assigned to infra-team on-call.

elaine_sales: Action list: (1) deepak - ops note + numbers by 2:30pm, (2) sam - cost delta table for sales/finance, (3) karen - draft DPA addendum + required attestation fields, (4) jamie - capex model template, (5) maria - host 4pm PT sync and send calendar. Post updates here. :thumbsup:
